title: ATICO _ Armchair
description: Atico Arm Chair is a piece of furniture that seamlessly blends functionality and aesthetics in its design. Its structure consists of a base that combines two wooden rings and tubes coated with electrostatic paint, serving both as support and legs.

The upholstery of this chair is a careful choice, using a green-toned fabric with a robust yet comfortable texture. This selection not only complements the color of the legs but also creates a pleasant contrast with the natural wood, achieving a visual and aesthetic balance.

The Atico Arm Chair stands out for its solid and inviting appearance. Although visually it appears to have generous padding and a perceptible weight, its ergonomic design ensures a comfortable experience for the user, embracing them in enveloping comfort.
